description.en: Opens a narration/monologue-style message box (centered, no speech-bubble tail) on a given screen and waits for it to finish.
Screen buffer to draw the monologue box on (e.g. SCREEN_B).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a narration monologue box
CreateMonologue("ev050", SCREEN_B);
